description: Extend the existing Convaudit site with a suite of social media calculators, beginning with an Engagement Rate Calculator reference implementation. Use a Next.js App Router server/client split, SEO-focused explanatory content, reusable JSON-LD, client-side-only calculations, and the existing Tailwind setup without adding dependencies unless essential.

services.name: Web application
services.features: Add a reusable social media calculator suite, initially an Engagement Rate Calculator; keep calculation logic entirely client-side; render SEO content and reusable JSON-LD from server components; isolate interactive calculator UI in client components; use existing Tailwind styles and dependencies where practical.

questions.question: Which language should the web application use?

options.label: TypeScript
options.description: Use the repository's existing TypeScript setup.

questions.rationale: The existing Next.js workspace is configured for TypeScript.

questions.question: Which Next.js App Router version should the implementation target, given the repository currently declares Next.js 16.4.3?

options.label: Next.js 15 App Router
options.description: Honor the requested Next.js 15 target, which may require changing the repository's current Next.js dependency.

options.label: Keep Next.js 16 App Router
options.description: Preserve the current repository dependency and implement the requested server/client split using its existing version.

questions.rationale: The request specifies Next.js 15, but the inspected workspace currently depends on Next.js 16.4.3.

questions.question: Which data stores or storage services does this project need?

options.label: No datastore required
